operator.domain: Four current original postQ1 rows x_i in a complete horizontal neighborhood; no second Q1 of virtual coordinates.
operator.coordinates: mu=mean_i x_i; delta_i=x_i-mu; sum_i delta_i=0. Three Haar directions span these centered four rows.
operator.preactivations: z0=W1*mu+b0; zhat_i=z0+B*delta_i; B=U_r*V_r acts only on centered contrasts.
operator.output: yhat_i=A*delta_i+W2*mean_j Phi(zhat_j)+b2; Phi is original BF16 tanhGELU/smooth2/group64 HiF4. All four approximate joint hidden rows are evaluated.
operator.equivalent_form: zhat_i=B*x_i+b0+(W1-B)*mu. This is a current-group-conditioned bias correction, not an invented generic low-rank identity.
operator.rounding: Real arithmetic formulas; implemented BF16 mean/Haar/GEMM/reconstruction and postQ2 pooling define a different rounded path. Native original-model controls remain unrun.

smooth_theorem.assumptions: phi has an L-Lipschitz Jacobian over every segment z0+u_i+t*e_i, u_i=B*delta_i,e_i=(W1-B)*delta_i,t in[0,1]. Real centered rows, fixed W1/B/b0.
proof: Integrate the Jacobian on each segment: phi(z0+u+e)-phi(z0+u)=J_phi(z0)*e + integral_0^1 (J_phi(z0+u+t*e)-J_phi(z0))*e dt.
Average: sum_i e_i=(W1-B)*sum_i delta_i=0, so the common first-order term vanishes.
Use the Lipschitz-Jacobian bound L*(norm(u_i)+t*norm(e_i))*norm(e_i) and integrate t.
smooth_theorem.implication: Scale all deltas by t with fixed mean, operators and local L: pooled smooth error is O(t^2). Full-input low-rank approximation also changes W1*mu, so its mean error need not vanish as t->0.
smooth_theorem.boundary: Not a theorem for discontinuous BF16/HiF4. The recorded synthetic original-quantizer case falsifies transferring the smooth bound across that boundary.

covariance_obstruction.assumptions: Centered four-row empirical covariance Sigma in input-feature space; any one symmetric two-point rule has covariance c*c^T of rank<=1.
covariance_obstruction.saved_input_result: Across each source median,56%-60% of empirical input contrast variance lies outside even the best one-dimensional subspace. A single two-point pair cannot preserve this covariance in all directions.
covariance_obstruction.limits: This is input-space geometry, not a lower bound on Wan nonlinear/output error. W1, Hessians, quantizer cells and gates may weight/annihilate directions. Spatial rank perstripe differs from the global feature rank r of B.

nearest_prior_art: ICCV2017 SVD bias compensation already derives b_hat=b+(W-B)*mean_x. The proposed changing local-current-group mean, pooled joint Q2, full W2 and own affine contrasts are the specific computation under investigation; no originality claim.
